def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    length = int(data[0].strip())
    if len(data) > 1:
        str_input = data[1].strip()
    else:
        str_input = ""
    max_length = 0
    count_length = 0
    count_word = 0
    checker = 0
    checker_inside = 0
    is_in_word_out = False
    is_in_word_in = False
    is_inside = False
    index = 0
    while index < length:
        if index < len(str_input):
            ch = str_input[index]
        else:
            ch = ''
        if ch == '(':
            is_inside = True
            checker_inside += 1
            if max_length < count_length:
                max_length = count_length
            count_length = 0
            is_in_word_out = False
        elif ch == ')':
            is_inside = False
            checker_inside = 0
            if checker > 0:
                count_word += 1
                checker = 0
        else:
            if checker_inside > 0:
                is_inside = True
        if index == length:
            break
        if ch != ')' and ch != '(':
            if not is_inside:
                if ch == '_':
                    if max_length < count_length:
                        max_length = count_length
                    count_length = 0
                    is_in_word_out = False
                else:
                    is_in_word_out = True
                if is_in_word_out:
                    count_length += 1
            else:
                is_in_word_out = False
                if ch == '_':
                    if checker > 0:
                        count_word += 1
                    checker = 0
                    is_in_word_in = False
                else:
                    is_in_word_in = True
                if is_in_word_in:
                    checker += 1
        index += 1
    if max_length < count_length:
        max_length = count_length
    print(f"{max_length} {count_word}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
